description: Yes or no: would an option with caffeine_content (attribute 1) at X mg per cup be rejected, for X from 10 to 50 in steps of 1. Asked with no trial, once per level, each in a fresh context, so no number can be copied off the options and the replies trace the stated cut as a curve (yes below it, no above it; under the paper rule the minimum is 35, and 35 itself passes). Asked, never scored: the answers are in reports_raw (with level and attribute) and in step_answers.md. A training answer, if it were ever trained on, is yes when X is below the probed attribute's minimum.
